sources.entry: Homepage by tomershvueli - Simple, standalone, self-hosted PHP page that is your window to your server and the web. MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: A simple, standalone, self-hosted PHP start page that shows rotating background images and a menu of your frequently used links.
use_cases: Start page for a home server or lab
Quick access to frequently used local and web links
Minimal browser landing page with changing backgrounds
Custom background images pulled from a JSON API
how_to_run: Edit config.json: set items, unlock_pattern, clock_format, and other options
Optionally add unsplash_client_id or custom_url / custom_url_selector for background images
Serve the project directory with Apache and PHP (PHP cURL required for external images)
Open the page in a browser
notable: Backgrounds rotate from Unsplash or a custom JSON URL every 20 seconds by default
Menu items are configured in a JSON file with Font Awesome icons or custom 80px images
{{cur}} placeholder lets links point to services on the current host
Optional idle timer hides the menu after inactivity
All assets bundled so it runs offline, minus remote background images
caveats: Unsplash demo API keys are limited to 50 requests per hour; the README advises a longer refresh interval
The README reports that upgrading to a Normal Unsplash API can lead to the key being shut down
Background images require PHP cURL and network access
